messages:
Aisha (CSM): Quick post-QBR pulse. Exec asked for a compact 'enablement gap' slide: onboarding % complete, top 3 blockers, and short mitigation owners. I pushed a draft slide into the deck: https://app.redwood.com/slides/box/qbr-ship-3 — please review.
Kenji (AE): Saw the deck — looks good. Need to call out the broker integration delay explicitly. Customer TTM slipped by 2 weeks.
Priya (CS Ops): I can own the onboarding completion numbers + chart. I'll pull current cohort metrics and update slide by noon. :calendar: 
Liam (Solutions Eng): I can add the demo failure postmortem (2nd step auth flake). I'll paste a short timeline and remediation plan.
Dan (Product): Flagging renewal risk: customer asked for SLA on model latency — we should add fallback plan to the mitigation column. I'll propose language.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks — owners summary for the slide: Priya -> completion data, Liam -> demo root cause + plan, Dan -> SLA/fallback wording, Kenji -> business impact blurb. Can someone tag legal if we mention SLA commit? @Kenji can you loop legal if needed?
Kenji (AE): Yup, looping legal. @legal-team FYI we may reference an SLA mitigation in the QBR slide; will only be high-level.
Priya (CS Ops): Paste for the slide: `Onboarding: 68% activated (vs 85% goal). Top blockers: 1) broker integration (ETA 2w), 2) SSO failures (intermittent), 3) missing training for ops users.` I'll attach a short csv snapshot.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Demo note (short): `Observed auth timeout when KV cache warmed on first session -> workaround: increase auth retry + cache priming; long-term: circuit-breaker + metrics to auto-warm.` Will write a 2-line mitigation and link to ticket CS-7894.
Aisha (CSM): Great. Two asks: 1) Please add your one-line owner text into the slide in the 'Mitigation owners' column. 2) We'll run an exec dry-run tomorrow 9:30am PT — be ready for 5-minute readout. Who can't make it?
Dan (Product): I can make it. Also adding a short note about fallbacks and rollback triggers.
Kenji (AE): I might be late by 10 mins, but will join. Adding legal contact in thread.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-7894 (Demo auth flake) and assigned to Liam. https://tracker.redwood.com/CS-7894
Aisha (CSM): Cool. I'll consolidate and circulate the final one-pager to the execs after the dry-run. Action items recap (brief):
• Priya: update onboarding numbers + chart (due today 12:00 PT)
• Liam: paste demo root cause + short mitigation (due today 16:00 PT)
• Dan: SLA/fallback text (due today 17:00 PT)
• Kenji: loop legal and add business impact blurb (due today 17:00 PT)
• Aisha: consolidate slide + run exec dry-run tomorrow 9:30am PT
If any blocker, ping me. :eyes:
